note: The cross-read for election coins (2026-10-10): each state's certified results publisher. A Polymarket election coin settles on the Conditional Tokens payout vector on Polygon; the state's certified result is the published cross-check named on the card and the coin page. Checked 2026-10-10 from a script: 'ok' = HTTP 200; 'bot-wall' = the official domain answered 403 to a script (it serves browsers). States not listed fall back to the U.S. Election Assistance Commission's directory of every state's election office. michigan.gov is the official page; mielections.us (the state's results site) did not resolve from the checking host.
